provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Concordia rules and Game Setup sheet (PD-Verlag)

steps.text: Choose the map: Imperium (3-5 players) or Italia (2-4 players)
Shuffle the 30 city tokens and place them letter side up on cities with the matching letter, then flip them
steps.note: The D tokens are not used on Italia

steps.text: Each province gets the bonus marker of its most valuable good (cloth, then wine, tools, food, bricks)
Sale cards: sort by Roman numeral, remove numerals higher than your player count, shuffle each and stack with I on top
Top 7 cards faceup in the display; the stack and the Concordia card by the board
1 land and 1 sea colonist in Roma; scoring marker on 0
Storehouse: 2 land and 2 sea colonists, 2 food, 1 cloth, 1 wine, 1 brick, 1 tool
Take your 15 houses and 7 starting cards
Random start player gets 5 sestertii, the second 6, and so on; the last player takes the Praefectus Magnus
On your turn play 1 card from your hand and carry out its action
